info.description: Admin-editable trial and reminder configuration for Stripe billing. Same pattern as tier-settings: no REST route, read server-side via strapi.documents('api::billing-settings.billing-settings').findFirst(). Prices themselves live in the Stripe dashboard (STRIPE_PRICE_* env vars).

trialDays.description: Length of the free trial new organizations get. 0 disables trials.

trialTier.description: Which tier's limits a trialing organization gets.

trialRequiresCard.description: If true, new organizations start on Free and the trial only begins when they enter a card at Stripe Checkout (charged automatically when it ends).

trialReminderDays.description: Days before trial end to email a reminder, e.g. [7, 3, 1].

renewalReminderDays.description: Days before a paid subscription renews to email a reminder, e.g. [30, 7, 1].

pastDueGraceDays.description: Days a past-due organization keeps its paid tier (with daily reminders) before dropping to Free.
